relations.reading: Cross-border legitimacy can support knowledge transfer, but the receiving operation still needs explicit roles, technical readiness and acceptance conditions.

relations.title: Madurez observable
relations.reading: The maturity model could make the institutional claim more inspectable by asking which practices, memory and responsibilities continue beyond an individual intervention.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: Legitimacy on both sides of a boundary can enable translation, but it does not itself grant authority to commit either side.
